Class ProcedureVersion

java.lang.Object
ai.gradientlabs.client.model.ProcedureVersion
public class ProcedureVersion extends Object
A specific version of a procedure.

Procedures can have multiple versions, with one marked as "live" (production) and optionally one marked as "gated" for controlled testing.

    • isGated

      public boolean isGated()
      Checks if this is a gated version.

      Gated versions are used before "live" versions, within the daily limit defined in the gated config.

      Returns:
      true if this is a gated version

    • setGated

    • isLive

      public boolean isLive()
      Checks if this is the "production" live version.

      The live version is used by the agent by default, if there are no gated versions or all of them have exceeded their limit.

      Returns:
      true if this is the live version
